title: Chest pain
summary: Chest pain can be a heart attack. Get help fast and keep them calm.
doSteps: Help them sit down and rest in a comfortable position, often half sitting.
Loosen tight clothing around the neck and chest.
If they have their own prescribed heart medicine, help them take it as their doctor told them.
Stay with them and note when the pain started.
If they stop breathing, start chest compressions if you know how.
dontSteps: Do not let them walk around or exert themselves.
Do not give food or drink.
Do not wait to see if the pain goes away before getting help.
